title: On the Nazarov--Shcheglova Conjecture for Sharp Sobolev Inequalities: The Case (n,p)=(3,2)
summary: For integers $n>k\geq0$ and $1\leq p,q\leq\infty$, let $λ_3(n,k,p,q)$ denote the optimal constant in the one-dimensional Sobolev inequality \[ \|u^{(k)}\|_{L^q(0,1)} \leq λ_3(n,k,p,q) \|u^{(n)}\|_{L^p(0,1)}, \qquad u\in\mathring W_p^n(0,1). \] Nazarov and Shcheglova \cite{NazarovShcheglova} conjectured that \[ λ_3(n,1,p,1) = 2λ_3(n,0,p,\infty), \qquad n\geq2,\quad 1\leq p\leq\infty, \] and that the corresponding extremal functions coincide and are symmetric about the midpoint of the interval.
